# DRVN Social

> DRVN Social is a data-driven social media marketing and video production agency based in Ebbw Vale, South Wales, UK. A film crew and a growth team under one roof: we make the content, run the ads (Meta, TikTok, YouTube) and report on the leads it brings in. We work with businesses across South Wales (Cardiff, Newport, Swansea, Bridgend, Caerphilly, Pontypridd, Merthyr Tydfil and the Valleys) and across the UK. Across clients: 60M+ views and 6,000+ leads generated.

Contact: hello@drvn.social · +44 (0) 2920 676 677 · 7 The Innovation Centre Workshops, Festival Drive, Ebbw Vale NP23 8XA
Founders: Aron Williams (Managing Director), Alex Bull (Creative Director)

## Services
- [Social media marketing agency, UK](https://drvn.social/social-media-agency-uk): UK-wide social media strategy, content, paid social, YouTube and reporting
- [Social media marketing agency, South Wales](https://drvn.social/social-media-agency-south-wales): strategy, short-form content, paid social, YouTube, community management and reporting
- [Social media agency, Cardiff](https://drvn.social/social-media-agency-cardiff): content, paid social and YouTube for Cardiff businesses
- [Social media agency, Newport](https://drvn.social/social-media-agency-newport): content, paid social and YouTube for Newport and Gwent businesses
- [Social media agency, Bridgend](https://drvn.social/social-media-agency-bridgend): the team behind Bridgend Ravens RFC's 11.8M views
- [Video production, South Wales](https://drvn.social/video-production-south-wales): brand films, social content, YouTube series, podcasts, recruitment films and video ads
- [Start a project](https://drvn.social/contact)
